messages:
Nina (growth): quick thread: planning a short pilot called 'Launch Lab' — 2-week sprint around a single vertical (SaaS product copy). core pieces: one 45-min webinar, 2 drop-in labs, a benchmark challenge with leaderboard, and a gated credits mechanic to force action. objective: drive meaningful first-5-requests and collect 5 one-sentence case blurbs for the benchmark narrative/launch post.

Rafael (content): nice. can we make the benchmark 'write 3 homepage hero variations' so it's tight and replicable? that gives us nice screenshots for the blog/LinkedIn.

Priya (events): dates proposal: webinar 2024-12-04, labs 12-06 and 12-11 (evening PT). i can reserve Zoom + record. also recommend a reminder cadence: reg confirmation, 24h before, 1h before, and a 24h post-event activation nudge.

Nina (growth): reminder cadence sounds good. gating idea: registrants get 5 starter credits, attendees who complete the benchmark get 40 credits. leaderboard incentive: top 10 submissions get an extra $200 credit and a small spotlight in the launch post. thoughts?

Eli (ops): auto-grant flow doable. need attendee CSV -> API job to call /grant_credits. sample payload below for eng: 
```
POST /internal/grants
{
  "user_email": "user@example.com",
  "amount": 4000,
  "reason": "launch_lab_attendee"
}
```
We should rate-limit grants and surface failures to #marketing-ops.

Tara (analytics): KPIs: reg -> attended -> benchmark_submitted -> claimed_reward -> first_5_requests -> day7_retention. baseline targets: 30% attendance, 40% submission rate among attendees, 25% reach first_5_requests. i'll produce an event schema and dashboard tile.

Rafael (content): creative plan: two launch posts — 1) 'Launch Lab results: how 50 teams shipped better copy in 24 hours' (benchmark narrative with leaderboard highlights), 2) 'Playbook: 3 templates to reduce copy revision cycles' (practical CTA). also will prepare three prompt templates and two short walkthrough videos (screen recordings).

Priya (events): registration page copy draft in #marketing-drafts in 10m. prefer we keep headline benefit-first: "Ship better product copy — in under an hour". also will collect one-line permission to quote when attendees submit.

Nina (growth): messaging test: subject A: "Your Launch Lab credits are waiting" vs subject B: "Ship 3 hero headlines in 30 minutes". call-to-action variants: Claim credits vs Start benchmark. we should A/B on registrants.

Eli (ops): also propose a safety: only grant the larger attendee credits after we see event:benchmark_submitted to prevent accidental grants. ops will add a webhook that checks event stream.

Tara (analytics): segmentation: brand-new accounts (created <7 days), trial users, and active customers. route trial users directly to advanced templates (higher difficulty). will output SQL segments by EOD.

Rafael (content): for the landing/LP i'll craft a compact FAQ: "How to claim credits", "What counts as a submission", "Privacy & data". also want one short testimonial blurb from product team to include in the hero.

Priya (events): logistics: need an ops checklist for recording, captioning, upload to CDN, and a short follow-up email w/ recording + prompt pack + leaderboard link. who owns the copy for follow-up?

Nina (growth): i'll own the 24h follow-up sequence and the leaderboard email. Rafael will provide the prompt pack. Eli will own the grant webhook. Priya owns recording & uploads. Tara owns dashboard and SQL segments.

Eli (ops): quick question: do we prefer a single grant reason code or separate per cohort? recommend per-cohort to help analytics: grant_reason = launch_lab_2024_12_v1.

Tara (analytics): agreed, please include grant_reason in the event payload so we can attribute conversions.

Rafael (content): timeline: drafts for LP, email series, and 3 prompts by 2024-11-12. recording templates and short walkthroughs by 2024-11-20. launch comms (LinkedIn + product blog) ready by 2024-12-10.

Priya (events): syncing calendar now. quick sync 2024-11-13 09:00 PT to finalize ops.

Nina (growth): pinging brand-bot to set reminders and collect tasks.

brand-bot: reminders set: sync-2024-11-13-09:00-PT; drafts-due-2024-11-12; ops-check-2024-11-20.

Tara (analytics): last note: capture benchmark metadata with these fields: submission_id, user_id, vertical(tag), model_used, tokens_used, submission_score (internal). i'll provide an example event schema in #analytics.

Nina (growth): perfect. final playbook bullets: narrow vertical, small leaderboard incentive, gated credits to force action, A/B subject + CTA, 24h activation nudge with templates, and two launch posts to recycle benchmark results. small and measurable. :dart: :sparkles:

Rafael (content): :rocket:

Priya (events): :calendar:

Eli (ops): :wrench:

brand-bot: task digest saved: [lp-draft, email-variants, grant-webhook, dashboard-tile, recording-checklist].
